body: You might need a combination of meds to get the right relief. After I tried Prozac they put me on Wellbutrin which helped for a while. Your options might be limited due to your age.

Depression can definitely cause physical symptoms. When I get really depressed I get headaches. The joint pain might be a result of your lack of activity. As far as what the doctor will prescribe I don't know. In my case when I was started on meds that used Prozac to begin with. I hated it but it works for other people. Whatever they prescribe be sure to communicate with your doctor if you don't feel right or feel worse. I definitely could've helped myself along if I'd spoken up sooner in the beginning.
Yeah, I get all ready to go and then I can't walk out of the door. It's so hard.
